text:
Predicates:
LargestCity(x, y) ::: x is the largest city in y.
City(x) ::: x is a city.
CapitalOf(x, y) ::: x is the capital of y.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
HostEvent(x, y) ::: x hosted event y.
HasEvent(x, y) ::: x has hosted event y.
RankedAmongBestUniversities(x) ::: x is a university ranked among the best in the world.
Universities(x) ::: x is a university.
Population(x, y) ::: x's population is y.
LargestPopulation(y) ::: y is the largest population.

Premises:
CapitalOf(Beijing, People'sRepublicOfChina) ::: Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China.
CapitalOf(Beijing, China) ::: Beijing is the capital city of the world's most populous nation.
LocatedIn(Beijing, NorthernChina) ::: Beijing is located in Northern China.
HostEvent(Beijing, SummerOlympics2008) ::: Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Olympics.
HostEvent(Beijing, SummerParalympics2008) ::: Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Paralympics Games.
HasEvent(Beijing, SummerOlympics2008) ::: Beijing has hosted the Summer Olympics.
HasEvent(Beijing, WinterOlympics2008) ::: Beijing has hosted the Winter Olympics.
HasEvent(Beijing, SummerParalympics2008) ::: Beijing has hosted the Summer Paralympics.
HasEvent(Beijing, WinterParalympics2008) ::: Beijing has hosted the Winter Paralympics.
UniversitiesIn(Beijing, x) ::: x is a university in Beijing.
∀x (UniversitiesIn(Beijing, x) → RankedAmongBestUniversities(x)) ::: Many of Beijing's universities are among the best.
NumberOfUniversitiesInBeijing(91) ::: Beijing has 91 universities.
Population(Beijing, y) ::: Beijing's population is y.

Conclusion:
¬LargestCity(x, China) ::: Beijing is not the largest city in China.
LargestCity(y, China) ::: y is the largest city in China.
Population(y, p) ::: y's population is p.
LargestPopulation(p) ::: p is the largest population.
